note: Identity match is solid and the declared HS is corroborated by real customs data. The ImportKey profile for slug 'jjd-enterprises' resolves to "JJD ENTERPRISES, 104, MALIK PUR, G.T.B. NAGAR" (Delhi), and one of the visible import rows carries HS 29321400 — "2026-02-21 | JK SUCRALOSE TRADE CO., LTD. | JJD ENTERPRISES | SUCRALOSE (JKSS00) (NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE) | Shanghai, CHINA | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | 29321400 | 7673214" — which matches the declared 293214 (sucralose/sweetener). Declared industry 'oil & gas / chemicals' is imprecise: the actual trade is food ingredients and high-intensity sweeteners (neotame, aspartame, sucralose, resistant dextrin, polydextrose), so the industry label should be corrected to food ingredients/sweeteners rather than treated as a rejection ground. Role is clearly a trader/importer-distributor, not a manufacturer: it buys from Wuhan Huasweet, Echemi Specialties, JK Sucralose Trade, Shandong Bailong Chuangyuan, Fuso Chemical, HSWT France, Baolingbao Biology and resells onward to Australia, Jordan and Nepal. Export side is confirmed by dated B/L records, not by website claims. Domestic (India) supply side could NOT be verified: web_search returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on every attempt and a direct Google query returned HTTP 429, while volza.com and eximpedia.app both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrievable, so domestic_status is 'unknown' with null evidence — this is a tooling gap, not a finding of absence. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the free view; the 220 figure is a shipment count, not a value, and must not be read as turnover). Owner name 'RANI SINGH' could not be corroborated from any source reached — no CIN, PAN or GSTIN obtained, all null. No rejection grounds: the entity is active with cargo as recent as 2026-02-26.
